# muxt fmt -d prints a unified diff of what formatting would change and
# exits 1; the file is not written.

! muxt fmt -d ugly.gohtml
cmp stdout want.diff
cmp ugly.gohtml ugly.orig

-- ugly.gohtml --
<ul>
<li>one</li>
</ul>
-- ugly.orig --
<ul>
<li>one</li>
</ul>
-- want.diff --
diff ugly.gohtml.orig ugly.gohtml
--- ugly.gohtml.orig
+++ ugly.gohtml
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 <ul>
-<li>one</li>
+	<li>one</li>
 </ul>
